title: Sparked
description: Sparked is a long-term hermitcraft styled java smp. We focus on creating cool builds and a fun social environment.
body:
## About us
We're a Long-Term SMP focused on building and creating a social environment with long-term projects and ambitious goals. We have minimal datapacks/mods all that don't interfere with the vanilla experience. So no land claims, warps, p2w etc! We're an adult server looking for more adults.

## Rules
We cover all the basics. A full list will be presented to you on application. But overall no griefing, stealing, trolling, cheating or unconsenting pvp! 

## Features
We have a few mods that enhance the vanilla experience. The classics like more mob heads, player heads, simple vc, armorstand poser and discord to minecraft chat link. A full list can be found in our discord. No mods or datapacks take away from or change any vanilla challenges.

## Our Vibes
Our server is primarily adults (18+) with an ever changing group of players. Consisting of  minecraft experts and newer players! Often you will find groups in the discord voice chat or hanging out in game with proximity chat!

## Application
You can apply to join today in our discord Our application is light-weight, quick and easy to follow. Its main purpose is to vibe check and filter out anyone with malicious intent. Join us today
